# Thexify

> Startup from Quito, Ecuador, founded in October 2025, that builds AI-powered software with Claude by Anthropic: SaaS products, internal tools, and AI assistants and automations. Works in English and Spanish. The English site is at the root; the Spanish site is under /es/.

- [Home](https://thexify.com/): what Thexify builds, about the startup, process and FAQ, with a contact form.
- [Contact](https://thexify.com/contact/): contact form and email.
- [Websites](https://thexify.com/websites/): a secondary service line: websites, websites with a dashboard and online stores.
- [Canangueno Lodge](https://thexify.com/work/canangueno-lodge/): bilingual tourism website redesign, in development.
- [SUNSU Cleaning Services](https://thexify.com/work/sunsu-cleaning/): cleaning services website in Quito.
- [Privacy](https://thexify.com/privacy/): how contact form data is handled.
- [Español](https://thexify.com/es/): sitio en español.

Business email: hola@thexify.com. Prices and timelines depend on scope. No guarantees of search rankings, sales or citations in AI assistants.
